title: Glacy vs Leafy | Which Pranky Evolution Is Tougher | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Both Pranky evolutions have one hundred and twenty HP and ninety five attack. Glacy is Ice and Water with magic defense one hundred and ten, and it is weak only to Grass. Leafy is Grass and Water with regen one hundred and six, but Lightning, Ice and Wind hit it hard. For a safer tank, pick Glacy. Which one is on your team? Comment below!

description: Aniimo Glacy vs Leafy: both Pranky evolutions have HP 120 and attack 95. Glacy (Ice and Water) has magic defense 110 and is weak to Grass; Leafy (Grass and Water) has regen 106 and is weak to Lightning, Ice and Wind. Checked on aniimo.gg and the Dexerto Aniimo wiki in November 2026.
